note: Early textual and institutional history traces how Jesus's status and church organization changed before Nicaea. Historical development of doctrine, not a primary attempt to prove or disprove its truth; V8 is not automatic. Different textual strata add learning. No single nation; church formation is treated as social history rather than philosophical doctrine. Endpoint 325, H13 capped. Original UK 2012 before Yale 2013.

title: Buddhism: A Journey through History
author: Donald S. Lopez Jr.
note: Historical movement of Buddhism across societies and institutions is the central purpose. Exposition of belief serves historical understanding, not truth assessment or a meditation program; no V7/V8 established. Distinct geographic adaptations add knowledge, though little direct domain fit. Broad cross-period account through present; no single endpoint or dominant rule-11/12 category.

title: The Buddha: Biography of a Myth
author: Donald S. Lopez Jr.
note: Studies how a religious figure's life has been constructed and transmitted. Historical myth formation and textual comparison supply transferable source-critical distinctions; not devotional biography or a truth argument merely from the subject. Different versions add learning. No specific historical endpoint because the object is the changing tradition, not only the ancient life. Low-confidence eligibility pending only limited publisher characterization, retained as eligible rather than inventing a veto.

author: Richard H. Davis
note: Religious cultures are traced through interaction and change in early India. Historical/social study, not religious truth assessment or practice advice. Distinct traditions and institutions add learning beyond a list of doctrines. India-centered cultural history warrants T11; explicit span ends 700 CE, H13 capped.

Food production, regulation, technology and consumption are examined as a system. Nutrition labeling is a policy topic, not a dominant personal diet plan; V7 not established. Separate production and distribution cases add learning. US food-system focus and environmental issues warrant T11; production rather than politics alone is central, T12 zero. Contentious conclusions are not in themselves ideological veto evidence.

Publisher presents practical advice on graduate school, obtaining an academic job and succeeding in an academic career. Career/life guidance is the dominant purpose rather than scientific organization as an explanatory system; V7. General career advice is not treated as a technical curriculum. Counterfactual score retains useful labor-market information and experience, while US academic context warrants T11. Density limited by advice applicability; no fixed historical period.

Language change, dialect mixing, creoles and standardization illustrate historical mechanisms. Explanatory linguistics, not language instruction. Contrasting processes add distinctions and boundary conditions rather than a single repeated anecdote. Transfer is indirect but real; no thematic deduction. Broad cross-period explanation, H13 zero.

Historical pronoun use explains linguistic change and challenges supposedly fixed grammar rules. Contemporary controversy is framing, while durable historical evidence remains; V4/V6 not established. Different pronouns add linguistic distinctions. Not a grammar-proficiency manual. Weak domain fit and narrow scope lower the score; no political deduction merely for touching a disputed pronoun.

author: Howard Mittelmark; Sandra Newman
note: Main purpose is to teach fiction-writing proficiency by identifying and correcting 200 writing errors. Publisher describes a practical guide built from teaching and editing experience. Procedural craft training triggers H3, irrespective of humor or illustrative fictional passages.
